an5.34:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.34:1.2: Atha kho Sīho senāpati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sīho senāpati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.34:1.3: Sakkā nu kho bhante sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetun ti?
an5.34:2.2: Dāyako Sīha dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo,
an5.34:2.3: yaṃ pi Sīha dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, idaṃ pi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ Sīha dāyakaṃ dānapatiṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti,
an5.34:3.2: yaṃ pi Sīha dāyakaṃ dānapatiṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti, idaṃ pi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ Sīha dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati,
an5.34:4.2: yaṃ pi Sīha dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, idaṃ pi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ Sīha dāyako dānapati yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto,
an5.34:5.2: yaṃ pi Sīha dāyako dānapati yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto, idaṃ pi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ Sīha dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati,
an5.34:6.2: yaṃ pi Sīha dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati, idaṃ pi samparāyikaṃ dānaphalan ti. 3.
an5.34:7.1: Evaṃ vutte Sīho senāpati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.34:7.2: Yānīmāni bhante Bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi, ahaṃ petāni jānāmi.
an5.34:7.3: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo manāpo.
an5.34:7.4: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, maṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti.
an5.34:7.5: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, mayhaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato ‘Sīho senāpati dāyako kārako saṅghupaṭṭhāko' ti.
an5.34:7.6: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkamāmi yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamāmi amaṅkubhūto.
an5.34:7.7: Yānīmāni bhante Bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi, ahaṃ petāni jānāmi.
an5.34:7.8: Yañ ca kho maṃ bhante Bhagavā evam āha:
an5.34:7.9: ‘dāyako Sīha dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatī' ti, etāhaṃ na jānāmi, ettha ca panāhaṃ Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmī' ti.
an5.34:7.11: dāyako Sīha dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatī' ti.
an5.34:8.1: Dadaṃ piyo hoti, bhajanti naṃ bahū,
an5.34:8.2: kittiñ ca pappoti yaso ca vaḍḍhati,
